title: PCW-14 — Cake, wishes and photo gathering
intent: Bring the existing real group together after the activities.

criteria.text: Cake invitation is unavailable until all six shared petals are committed.
Only present Phuong or an explicitly configured host fallback may invite/cut; host is unset by default.
Players walk voluntarily with independent cameras; no full-roster gate, forced teleport, or forced camera switch.
Guests may eat and continue activities after cutting; the personal birthday note remains empty and user-authored.
